_comment: Extra models offered in the Settings dropdowns, on top of the built-in list.
Edit this file to add a model permanently, or just type a model name into the
'Other' box in Settings and it will be added here automatically.
Each entry: id (what is passed to --model), label (shown in the dropdown),
note (the small grey text), alias (true if it always tracks the newest model
in its family), tier (1 fastest/cheapest .. 3 most capable).
Prefer an alias such as 'opus' or 'sonnet' over a pinned id: aliases follow the
newest model automatically, so nothing here needs updating when one ships.
